intro: Monday June 29 morning tactical ideas for the June 30 (Tuesday) US and Korean sessions. The week opens with ONE binary resolution and TWO new developments: (RESOLUTION TODAY) NVDA Stop Day 2 — June 29 US close above/below $195 determines framework for June 30 (premarket $195.15 is favorable but only the close counts); (NEW POSITIVE) Micron Q3 FY2026 +15.7% earnings beat — most powerful HBM supercycle validation of the cycle at US-listed tier; HBM4 sold out through 2026; $50B Q4 guide confirmed; (NEGATIVE SURPRISE) Samsung Blue House sell-the-news — ₩800T ($518B) vs. ₩1,000T ($648B) expected; KOSPI −3.4% at open, recovered to ~−0.2% (~8,394); SK Hynix entry conditions both failed; HOLD MEDIUM. SPX futures approaching 7,460 regime gate (within 10 pts — best since May 14). BTC Day 7 exit gate active ($60,087). SPCX bond distribution Day 5 volume read pending today. For June 30 session: (1) NVDA framework determined by June 29 close — act accordingly; (2) SK Hynix June 30 KST is first re-entry assessment (KOSPI > 8,500 AND SK Hynix > ₩2,700,000 required); (3) MU: buy the dip if below $1,200 — Micron earnings validation is actionable now; (4) BTC: remain flat/cash; (5) SPCX: step aside; (6) NFP July 2 into 3-day July 4 holiday gap is the macro binary that determines June 30 positioning discipline.

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: BUY on dip below $1,200 — Micron Q3 FY2026 +15.7% revenue beat is the most powerful HBM supercycle validation of the 2026 cycle at the US-listed tier. HBM4 capacity sold out through 2026. $50B Q4 FY2026 guide confirmed (40%+ above prior consensus). Samsung $226B AI data centers (confirmed June 29) is the single most powerful external demand validation of Micron's $50B guide — at current HBM pricing, $226B in AI data centers implies multi-year HBM demand that extends the sold-out cycle. Russell Growth reclassification June 26 creates permanent passive demand from Growth ETFs.
ideas.why: Two simultaneous demand validations make the Morningstar supply-glut thesis untenable: (1) Micron Q3 +15.7% beat with HBM4 sold out through 2026 — US-listed tier confirmation; (2) Samsung $226B AI data center commitment — Korean national-government scale confirmation. Goldman, BofA, Citigroup, JPMorgan underwrote the SK Hynix $29.4B ADR (the same institutions that confirmed multi-year HBM demand before committing), validating Micron's $50B guide independently. The only US-headquartered HBM supplier benefits from both the Samsung national demand signal and the domestic CHIPS Act manufacturing mandate. MU's June 29 session open will reflect the +15.7% after-hours move — buy the pullback, not the gap.
ideas.trigger: MU opens below $1,200 on June 29 or June 30 → buy; if MU opens above $1,250 without pullback, wait for $1,200 zone; stop $1,050 on two consecutive closes below; size 25–40% of full position — SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 required for full allocation.
ideas.risk: Samsung Honam semiconductor plant ($194B) includes competing DRAM production that undercuts Micron pricing power; NFP July 2 hot print (+200K) drives tech multiple compression ahead of MU Q4 earnings (~September 2026); MU gaps to $1,300+ with no pull-to-buy-zone entry; SPX fails to clear 7,460 gate on NVDA stop trigger, creating broad AI semi multiple compression.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.idea: Stop Day 2 binary resolves at June 29 US close — the fulcrum session is TODAY. Premarket $195.15 (above $195 threshold) is favorable but ONLY the daily close counts. For June 30: if June 29 closes above $195 → stop resets inactive; hold at medium conviction; next add requires both SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17. If June 29 closes below $195 → FULL EXIT at close or June 30 open; no re-entry until SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 AND NVDA > $205 simultaneously. WATCH ONLY for June 30 session — framework determined by June 29 close.
ideas.why: NVDA closed $192.53 June 26 (−2.20%) despite the $334B Nasdaq reconstitution — largest passive buying event in exchange history produced a lower close. Stop Day 1 activated. June 29 premarket $195.15 reflects Micron +15.7% lifting AI semis broadly and Samsung AI data center demand confirmation ($226B). Samsung Blue House sell-the-news (KOSPI sell-off) did NOT materially reduce NVDA premarket bid — the Micron demand validation was the stronger US-market force. However, an intraday gap that fails to hold through the session close still triggers the stop — only the June 29 daily close matters for the June 30 framework.
ideas.trigger: June 29 premarket above $195.15 (favorable setup) → hold through close; June 29 close above $195 → stop resets; upgrade June 30 to medium HOLD; next add framework $205 when SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 simultaneously. June 29 close below $195 → FULL EXIT at close or June 30 open; no re-entry until SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 AND NVDA > $205.
ideas.risk: Intraday gap-up from Micron bid fades before June 29 US close; NFP pre-positioning risk-off (institutions de-risking ahead of July 2 into holiday gap) overwhelms Micron catalyst; NVDA-specific negative (hyperscaler capex guidance cut, supply chain commentary); SPX fails to clear 7,460 on June 29, creating a regime-gate overhang that caps NVDA even if it closes above $195.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc.
ideas.idea: HOLD MEDIUM — entry conditions both failed on June 29 sell-the-news (SK Hynix ₩2,624,000 < ₩2,700,000 threshold; KOSPI < 8,500). No new position added per protocol. June 30 KST (Tuesday) is the first re-entry assessment session. BUY MEDIUM conviction restores IF: (1) KOSPI June 30 KST close above 8,500 AND (2) SK Hynix June 30 KST close above ₩2,700,000 — both simultaneously. Stop ₩2,540,000 UNCHANGED; buffer compressed to ₩84,000 (3.2%) from ₩2,624,000. ADR Nasdaq July 10 unchanged; underwriter mandate (BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) provides institutional floor above stop.
ideas.why: Samsung Blue House ₩800T ($518B) vs. ₩1,000T ($648B) expected — magnitude disappointment triggered sell-the-news cascade. Structural thesis intact: Samsung $226B AI data centers confirmed; ADR July 10 unchanged; Micron +15.7% independently validates HBM demand from US-listed tier. KOSPI intraday V-recovery to ~−0.2% (~8,394) confirms ADR underwriter bid is structural and real — sell-the-news exhausted intraday. FSS postponed new weekly options (new negative for near-term liquidity). The compressed stop buffer (3.2%) is the primary tactical risk management issue for June 30.
ideas.trigger: June 30 KST close above ₩2,700,000 AND KOSPI close above 8,500 → restore BUY MEDIUM; add 50% position on June 30 close; assess second 50% after July 1 KST stabilization. If KOSPI closes below 8,200 OR SK Hynix closes below ₩2,580,000 on June 30 → Stop Day 1 proximity alert. Stop ₩2,540,000 unchanged (two consecutive KST closes below = mandatory full exit).
ideas.risk: NFP July 2 hot print into 3-day July 4 holiday gap tests KOSPI below 8,200 before June 30 re-entry conditions are met; stop ₩2,540,000 triggered before ADR July 10 underwriter mandate takes full effect; ADR pricing supplement (July 7) prices below implied KRX equivalent creating downward arbitrage pressure; FSS additional regulatory actions on SK Hynix beyond weekly options postponement.

ideas.name: Bitcoin / US Dollar
ideas.idea: Remain FLAT/CASH. Day 7 exit gate active. $60,087 at 11:30 UTC June 29. Fear & Greed 12 (Extreme Fear deepening). Samsung sell-the-news failed to generate BTC risk-on rally toward $62,000 re-entry gate — the cross-asset catalyst the June 28 framework identified did NOT materialize. $1,913 from the $62,000 two-close re-entry gate. BTC re-entry clock inactive. Do NOT re-enter BTC before two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000, and do NOT re-enter before NFP July 2 resolves even if two-close clock activates.
ideas.why: IBIT June 26 outflows $445M (second-largest in streak); weekly outflows ~$1.3B. Fear & Greed at 12 — historically a contrarian accumulation signal but does not override the two-close-$62,000 gate framework. BTC-AI semi correlation did NOT hold on June 29 (Samsung sell-the-news failed to produce NVDA gap-up that could have pulled BTC above $60,500+). $10.6B quarterly BTC options expiry and sustained IBIT outflows are structural headwinds. The $60,000 level is psychologically important but technically the $58,100 structural support (June 25 low) is the level that would force the downside framework reassessment.
ideas.trigger: June 29 20:00 UTC close above $62,000 → Day 1 of re-entry clock (low probability given Samsung sell-the-news and current $60,087); watch June 30 20:00 UTC close if Day 1 activates. Two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 → re-enter at 50% position size. Stop: two consecutive UTC closes below $60,000 after re-entry. Do NOT re-enter before NFP July 2.
ideas.risk: Samsung sell-the-news drives BTC below $59,000 intraday before June 29 UTC close (tests June 28 low $59,748); NVDA stop triggers on June 29 US close (risk-off contagion drives BTC below $59,000 toward $58,100 structural level); NFP July 2 strong print (+200K) into 3-day holiday gap forces BTC below $58,100 — activates structural downside framework.

ideas.name: Procure Space ETF
ideas.idea: STEP ASIDE HIGH conviction — zero position. Bond distribution Day 5 is Monday June 29 (volume read pending 9:30 AM ET open). Samsung sell-the-news removes the macro risk-on X-factor that could have modestly reduced Day 5 distribution selling — Day 5 volume may trend toward 100–140M shares (higher end of prior estimate) rather than the 60–80M target with Samsung boost. Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 (~$4.3B passive) remains the known demand catalyst at the clearance window. IG floor $150 watch without Samsung tailwind. Do NOT re-enter before clearance confirmed (volume below 5M shares/day for 2–3 sessions) AND two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume.
ideas.why: SpaceX $25B bond distribution mechanics are structural, not sentiment-driven — Samsung sell-the-news eliminates the discretionary selling reduction that could have accelerated normalization. Day 4 (June 26) volume 126.91M shares remains far above the 5M clearance signal. Without the Samsung X-factor, Day 5 normalization pace may extend the July 7–10 clearance window by 1–2 sessions. The Russell 1000 reconstitution precedent (June 26: $158.40 intraday → $152.15 close) remains the template for how Nasdaq 100 passive inclusion will be absorbed by distribution if supply persists on July 7.
ideas.trigger: Volume below 5M shares/day for 2–3 consecutive sessions (est. July 7–10, possibly July 9–12 without Samsung boost) → clearance confirmed; then two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. If June 29 close below $150 → IG floor failure Day 1 → framework reassessment required. Do NOT re-enter on single-session Nasdaq 100 inclusion spike.
ideas.risk: IG floor $150 closing breach on Day 5 without Samsung tailwind (distribution volume 140M+ overwhelms structural bid); Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 absorbed by distribution exactly as Russell 1000 addition was June 26 ($158.40 intraday → $152.15 close); clearance extends beyond July 10 due to Samsung X-factor elimination; September 2 first earnings is the only remaining catalyst powerful enough to override distribution mechanics.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms Inc.
ideas.idea: Low-conviction watch: META is the best-risk-adjusted big-tech add once regime gates clear. SPX futures approaching 7,460 gate (within 10 pts — best position since May 14) — if June 29 close achieves SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 simultaneously, META becomes the first big-tech name to add on June 30. Micron +15.7% AI demand validation lifts the AI compute context that benefits Meta's advertising AI thesis (more AI compute = more AI ad optimization demand = higher CPM growth for META's $160B+ annual ad revenue).
ideas.why: META is the reported anchor customer for Qualcomm Dragonfly AI chip — structural hedge against NVIDIA dependency not yet priced. Reality Labs losses decelerating. Threads/Instagram AI engagement accelerating. Samsung $226B AI data centers (confirmed despite magnitude gap) validates the AI data center buildout narrative that benefits Meta's AI training and inference infrastructure. Llama 4 open-source adoption creating enterprise AI ecosystem. PEG discount vs. MSFT and GOOGL at current multiples. META is the first big-tech name to add because it has the most AI-driven revenue growth and the least regulatory overhang relative to its multiple.
ideas.trigger: SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 at daily close simultaneously (regime cleared, requires June 29 close confirmation) → add META on June 30 open. Stop: 7% below entry. Target: 10% above entry on 4-week horizon. Do NOT add before June 29 close resolves regime gate status.
ideas.risk: Regime gates remain breached through June 29 close (SPX fails to close above 7,460); NVDA stop triggers on June 29 close, adding risk-off pressure that prevents regime clearance; FTC/EU regulatory action on Meta AI data practices; Qualcomm Dragonfly partnership delayed or reported inaccurately.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Low-conviction watch: MSFT is the enterprise AI moat play in big-tech with the most direct read-through from Samsung Blue House ($226B AI data centers confirmed despite magnitude gap). Samsung AI data centers require Azure-compatible workloads and enterprise AI software — MSFT benefits as the AI software layer regardless of hardware vendor. Micron +15.7% validates the AI infrastructure demand expansion that underpins MSFT's $50B+ Azure AI capex plan. Do NOT add before regime gates clear (SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17).
ideas.why: Azure is #2 hyperscaler growing faster than AWS on AI workloads. OpenAI partnership gives MSFT exclusive commercial rights to GPT-5/6 on Azure. Copilot for M365 (1.4B Office users) is the largest enterprise AI distribution channel. GitHub Copilot (1.4M+ paid seats). Samsung $226B AI data centers = global AI compute demand beyond what Azure and US hyperscalers are already building; incremental demand not in current consensus MSFT addressable market estimates. Micron $50B Q4 guide + Samsung $226B AI capex = two simultaneous demand validations that re-rate the AI infrastructure TAM underpinning MSFT's growth thesis.
ideas.trigger: SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 at daily close simultaneously (regime cleared) → add MSFT on following session open. Stop: 7% below entry. Target: 10% above entry on 4-week horizon.
ideas.risk: Regime gates remain breached; OpenAI relationship deteriorates; GOOGL Workspace + Gemini gains enterprise share faster than MSFT Copilot; Samsung builds Azure-competitive cloud services with $226B AI data center commitment; NVDA stop trigger on June 29 creates broad AI sector risk-off preventing regime clearance.
